title: Georgia Power: only his house lost a leg of power
summary: Mario Woods tells of Georgia Power: only his house lost a leg of power, about December 2017 at his home, Georgia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: you mean he goes well you lit up our board downtown like the Fourth of July

plain: A former guard at a nuclear site named Mario Woods, who says he was abducted, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in December 2017 his home in Georgia lost one leg of its electric power. He says a supervisor at Georgia Power, the local electric company, told him only his house was affected and that it "lit up our board downtown like the Fourth of July," and he has photos of the transformer. If true, something unusual struck his home's power that night.
